_metadata.source: Literature synthesis from multiple DTI tractography studies and classic neuroanatomy
_metadata.description: Major white matter tracts of the human brain, organized by fiber type classification, with connected brain regions
_metadata.note: Connections listed are well-established in the literature. Exact gray matter termination zones may vary by tractography protocol.

association_tracts.description: Connect cortical regions within the same hemisphere

tracts.name: Cingulum (Cingulum Bundle, CB)
tracts.function: Emotion processing, memory, visuospatial processing, DMN connectivity
tracts.notes: Main white matter bundle of the limbic system. Projects bidirectionally through the limbic lobe.

tracts.name: Arcuate Fasciculus (AF)

subdivisions.long_segment: Direct connection between frontal and temporal language areas
subdivisions.anterior_segment: Between Broca's area and inferior parietal lobule
subdivisions.posterior_segment: Between inferior parietal lobule and Wernicke's area

connected_regions: Broca's area (pars opercularis, pars triangularis, BA44/45)
Wernicke's area (posterior superior temporal gyrus, BA22)
tracts.function: Language repetition, phonological processing, syntactic processing, auditory-motor integration
tracts.notes: Often considered the direct segment of the broader SLF/AF complex

tracts.name: Superior Longitudinal Fasciculus (SLF)

connected_regions: Superior frontal gyrus (dorsal premotor / supplementary motor area)
SLF_I.function: Processing spatial coordinates of trunk/limbs, movement planning

connected_regions: Middle frontal gyrus (including frontal eye fields, BA8)
Inferior parietal lobule (supramarginal gyrus, anterior angular gyrus)
Posterior inferior frontal gyrus (pars opercularis, ventral premotor)

connected_regions_summary: Frontal lobe (superior, middle, inferior frontal gyri)
Parietal lobe (superior and inferior parietal lobules)
tracts.lateralization: Rightward asymmetries in volume and microstructure
tracts.notes: Largest association tract complex. SLF III overlaps with the anterior segment of AF.

tracts.name: Uncinate Fasciculus (UF)
tracts.function: Episodic memory, language (rapid naming), semantic associations, social-emotional processing, decision-making
tracts.notes: Hook-shaped bundle. Combines somatosensory information with emotional response regulation.

tracts.name: Inferior Longitudinal Fasciculus (ILF)
connected_regions: Occipital lobe (lateral occipital cortex, occipital pole)
Anterior temporal lobe (fusiform gyrus, temporal pole)
tracts.function: Face and emotion recognition, visual association, object recognition (ventral visual stream), reading
tracts.notes: Major white matter bundle of the ventral visual stream ('what' pathway)

tracts.name: Inferior Fronto-Occipital Fasciculus (IFOF)
connected_regions: Frontal lobe (orbital cortex, lateral prefrontal cortex, inferior frontal gyrus)
Occipital lobe (lateral occipital cortex, occipital pole)
Temporal lobe (passes through; connects to temporo-basal areas)
tracts.function: Semantic processing, visual processing, reading, attentional functions
tracts.notes: The longest association pathway. Runs along the external capsule. May be unique to humans.

tracts.name: Middle Longitudinal Fasciculus (MdLF)
tracts.function: Auditory/linguistic processing (less well-characterized)
tracts.notes: Less consistently described across tractography protocols

tracts.name: Vertical Occipital Fasciculus (VOF)
connected_regions: Rest of brain (forms part of sagittal stratum)
tracts.function: Visual processing integration

tracts.name: Extreme Capsule (EmC)
tracts.function: Language, syntax, grammar

tracts.name: External Capsule
tracts.function: Frontostriatal connectivity

commissural_tracts.description: Connect corresponding regions across the two cerebral hemispheres

tracts.name: Corpus Callosum

subdivisions.body: Connects bilateral frontal and parietal lobes
subdivisions.isthmus: Connects bilateral temporal and parietal lobes
subdivisions.tapetum: Connects bilateral temporal regions (lateral ventricles roof)

connected_regions: All homologous cortical areas across hemispheres
tracts.function: Interhemispheric communication, higher-order cognition
tracts.notes: Largest white matter bundle in the brain

tracts.name: Anterior Commissure
connected_regions: Temporal cortex (middle and inferior temporal gyri)
tracts.function: Interhemispheric temporal and olfactory communication

tracts.name: Posterior Commissure
tracts.function: Pupillary light reflex, vertical gaze

tracts.name: Hippocampal Commissure
tracts.notes: Part of the forniceal commissural system (psalterium)

tracts.name: Habenular Commissure
tracts.function: Limbic circuitry

projection_tracts.description: Connect cerebral cortex with subcortical structures (thalamus, basal ganglia, brainstem, spinal cord)

tracts.name: Corticospinal Tract (Pyramidal Tract)

targets: Spinal cord anterior horn (lower motor neurons)

tracts.function: Voluntary movement control
tracts.notes: Major efferent pathway for voluntary movement. ~1 million axons.

tracts.name: Corticobulbar Tract

targets: Cranial nerve motor nuclei (CN V, VII, IX, X, XI, XII)

tracts.function: Control of facial muscles, jaw, pharynx, larynx, tongue
tracts.notes: Lies medial/dorsal to corticospinal fibers. Mostly bilateral innervation (except lower face, which is contralateral).

tracts.name: Corona Radiata

ascending_afferent: Thalamic radiations (thalamo-cortical fibers to all cortical lobes)

tracts.function: Fan-shaped convergence of projection fibers between cortex and internal capsule

tracts.name: Internal Capsule
tracts.function: Compact band of projection fibers flanked by caudate, lenticular nucleus, and thalamus

tracts.name: Thalamic Radiations (Peduncles)

subdivisions.anterior_thalamic_peduncle: Frontal lobe connections (MD nucleus, anterior nuclei)

connected_regions_summary: Mediodorsal (MD) thalamic nucleus ↔ orbitofrontal/polar prefrontal cortex
Anterior thalamic nuclei ↔ ventromedial prefrontal / cingulate cortex
Lateral geniculate (LGN) → primary visual cortex (via optic radiations)
Medial geniculate (MGN) → primary auditory cortex (via auditory radiations)

tracts.name: Fornix

subdivisions.precommissural_fornix: Projects to septal region and nucleus accumbens
subdivisions.postcommissural_fornix: Projects to mammillary bodies, anterior thalamus, hypothalamus

tracts.function: Memory formation (Papez circuit), emotional processing
tracts.notes: C-shaped bundle. Also contains some afferent fibers to hippocampus from septal/hypothalamic nuclei.

tracts.name: Optic Radiations (Geniculocalcarine Tract)

subdivisions.upper_division: Carries information from inferior visual field → cuneus (above calcarine fissure)
subdivisions.lower_division_Meyers_loop: Carries information from superior visual field → lingual gyrus (below calcarine fissure)

connected_regions: Primary visual cortex (V1, pericalcarine cortex, BA17)
tracts.function: Vision (relays retinal input from LGN to V1)
tracts.notes: Forms part of the sagittal stratum in the temporal lobe

inferior_cerebellar_peduncle_ICP.function: Sensory input from spinal cord and brainstem

tracts.name: Corticopontine Fibers
tracts.function: Part of cortico-ponto-cerebellar circuit for motor coordination and learning

cerebellar_tracts.description: White matter pathways connecting cerebellum with the rest of the brain
